title: Twistx
description: Adds weather and other tech Items
body:
🔧⚙️🌪️ Modpack Description

Welcome to Twistx, a progression-driven Minecraft modpack built for players who love technology, automation, and large-scale systems—all while surviving a world that actively fights back.

Start from humble beginnings and advance through powerful machines, automated resource processing, and advanced infrastructure. Build massive factories, deploy quarries to harvest resources, and design intelligent storage networks that keep your operation running smoothly.

But Twistx isn’t just about building—it’s about enduring.

🌪️ Dynamic Battle Weather brings the world to life with tornadoes, hurricanes, violent storms, and extreme weather systems that can reshape the terrain and threaten your bases. Prepare your builds, reinforce critical systems, and adapt your automation to survive nature’s wrath.

Expect:

⚙️ Technology & Automation – Machines, power generation, and full-scale automation

⛏️ Quarries & Resource Generation – Industrial mining at massive scale

📦 Advanced Storage Systems – Manage enormous inventories efficiently

🌪️ Battle Weather & Natural Disasters – Tornadoes, hurricanes, and destructive storms

🔁 Progression-Focused Gameplay – Earn power and efficiency through smart advancement

🏗️ Builder-Friendly Design – Functional factories without sacrificing aesthetics

Perfect for solo worlds or multiplayer servers, Twistx offers a long-term experience where engineering, survival, and environmental chaos collide.

Build the machines. Brace for the storm. Control the chaos. ⚡🌩️
